newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products steady to easier, but mkt quiet.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products steady to easier, but mkt quiet.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were steady to easier on Friday in quiet trade.

Gas oil slipped $2.75 a tonne on easier futures. The market remains long, with two Russian and one Bulgarian heating oil cargoes on offer and a one percent sulphur heating oil cargo available from Lavera.
Heating oil premiums were around high cif quotes flat basis Genoa, steady to slightly easier.

The further opening of arbitrage opportunities to Asia has triggered a rise in freight rates by some 30 percent from last week, according to one estimate, complicating efforts to charter vessels to move material east. Low sulphur diesel remains quiet and premiums notionally steady.
Naphtha held steady in quiet activity. Traders said the market looked fairly balanced with bids scarce and cargo offers thin.
Cargoes of Egyptian and Algerian naphtha, are seen available around the end of the month. Traders said the cargoes may go transatlantic unless European demand picks up.
Cif deliveries were talked in a wide $217/$220 range.
Gasoline was steady to firmer with some trade house buying interest for product to go into Africa and firmer NWE markets supportive as local demand stayed thin.
Premium unleaded cargoes were valued around $2.50 firmer at $223.50 a tonne cif Lavera.
The high sulphur cracked fuel oil market was steady with details of a 50,000 tonne cargo done yesterday into Romania still not forthcoming.
